answer: A shipping exchange buying tide forecasts for an onyx cargo voyage can cap each provider's outstanding orders by collateral held in escrow. Reserve collateral against every order's maximum loss until delivery and disputes end; give new keys no starter credit. Splitting the same deposit among aliases then leaves total order capacity unchanged. To expand a Sybil fleet, an attacker must finance more locked capital and risk forfeiture for proven fraud. This requires linear credit limits, reliable adjudication, and no double pledging of collateral.
